SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Name the president
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

2. Which statement about Slavery and Servitude is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Slavery and Servitude.
   B. Say Slavery and Servitude never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Slavery and Servitude with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Slavery and Servitude as rumours only.

3. Which statement about Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies.
   C. Treat Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies as rumours only.
   D. Explain Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. Which statement about Historical Development of Agriculture is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Historical Development of Agriculture with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Historical Development of Agriculture never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Historical Development of Agriculture.
   D. Treat Historical Development of Agriculture as rumours only.

5. Which statement about Human Origin is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Human Origin never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Human Origin with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Human Origin as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Human Origin.

6. Which statement about Historical information is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Historical information never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Historical information with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Historical information.
   D. Treat Historical information as rumours only.

7. Which statement about Self- Exploration is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Self- Exploration.
   B. Explain Self- Exploration with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Self- Exploration as rumours only.
   D. Say Self- Exploration never happens in Kenya.

8. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Plan income and spending wisely
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Avoid saving forever

9. Which statement about Diversity and interpersonal relationships is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Diversity and interpersonal relationships as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Diversity and interpersonal relationships.
   C. Explain Diversity and interpersonal relationships with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Diversity and interpersonal relationships never happens in Kenya.

10. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Mombasa
   C. Nakuru
   D. Kisumu

11. Which statement about Maps and Map Work 10 4.4 Earth and the Solar System 5 4.5 Weather 5 Page 13 of 6 is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Maps and Map Work 10 4.4 Earth and the Solar System 5 4.5 Weather 5 Page 13 of 6 with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Maps and Map Work 10 4.4 Earth and the Solar System 5 4.5 Weather 5 Page 13 of 6 as rumours only.
   C. Say Maps and Map Work 10 4.4 Earth and the Solar System 5 4.5 Weather 5 Page 13 of 6 never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Maps and Map Work 10 4.4 Earth and the Solar System 5 4.5 Weather 5 Page 13 of 6.

12. Which statement about Peaceful Coexistence is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Peaceful Coexistence.
   B. Explain Peaceful Coexistence with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Peaceful Coexistence as rumours only.
   D. Say Peaceful Coexistence never happens in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Early Civilisation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Slavery and Servitude and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Developments in Medium of trade and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Diversity and interpersonal relationships and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
